_comment: Golden vocabulary vector for a Signal's data_type. One dataset judged by the Python suite (contracts/tests/test_signal_data_type.py) and by every editor that offers a data type picker. A Signal takes these lowercase names, not the Constant vocabulary ('Float64', 'Int64') and not 'float64'; a write with any other name is refused.
_arrays_comment: Array variants exist on the server (int_array, float_array, …) and are deliberately NOT offered by the entity editor. They are excluded here so this vector says what a picker may present, not everything the column accepts.
